about.title: About Ibaraki Discovery
about.subtitle: Your portal to an authentic Japanese experience
about.missionP1: Ibaraki Discovery was born from a vision: promoting sustainable and authentic tourism by redirecting visitors from overcrowded destinations like Tokyo and Kyoto to the hidden treasures of Ibaraki Prefecture.
about.missionP2: Located just 1h-1h30 from Tokyo, Ibaraki offers a peaceful and culturally rich alternative, with spectacular natural landscapes, deep historical heritage, and unique gastronomy.
about.missionP3: Our platform allows you to create personalized itineraries based on your preferences, budget, length of stay and season of visit.
about.authenticityDesc: We highlight authentic local experiences and preserved traditions of Ibaraki.
about.sustainabilityDesc: We promote responsible tourism that respects the environment and local communities.
about.personalizationDesc: Every traveler is unique. We create tailor-made experiences adapted to your desires.
about.why1Desc: Accessible in 1h-1h30 from Tokyo, perfect for a getaway
about.why2Desc: Flower parks, sacred mountains, waterfalls and beaches
about.why3Desc: Ancient shrines, temples, museums and living traditions
about.why4Desc: Local specialties like monkfish (anko) and fresh produce
about.why5Desc: Enjoy a peaceful experience away from the crowds
